title: Judy Justice
description: Voted against removing diversity, equity, and inclusion references from the district’s strategic plan.
body:
# Judy Justice

# Board of Education Member

![](/media/uploads/2026/07/judy-justice.png)

- [Voted against](https://web.archive.org/web/20260415065744/https:/www.whqr.org/local/2025-02-26/new-hanover-county-school-board-votes-5-2-to-remove-references-to-dei) removing diversity, equity, and inclusion references from the district’s strategic plan.
- [Said that](https://web.archive.org/web/20250724192454/https:/www.whqr.org/local/2025-01-28/how-cape-fear-region-schools-are-responding-to-new-ice-policy-increased-activity) if ICE officers came on the school campus it would be a “traumatizing scenario.”
- Made a [social media post](https://restoration-news.com/getmedia/f41b491b-0df8-4657-be79-2688d82def77/NC-New-Hanover-Judy-Justice-Trump-starved-children.png) claiming Trump caused the starvation of children.
- On [social media post](https://restoration-news.com/getmedia/847275c2-8f7f-4285-a61f-d0b43365d331/New-Hanover-Justice-Clarence-Thomas.png) called Clarence Thomas a “corrupt judge.”
- [Claimed](https://restoration-news.com/getmedia/93d08356-a716-41d5-be96-825f8f991884/NC-New-Hanover-Judy-Justice-DEI-racists.png) anyone who supported getting rid of DEI are “racist, ignorant haters.”

![](/media/uploads/2026/07/Picture1-1.png)

- [Posted](https://restoration-news.com/getmedia/d2b8fc62-45e1-407f-b50d-03f322716f29/NC-New-Hanover-Judy-Justice-female-professions.png) that “Female dominated professions are treated as “less then” in our masculine controlled culture.”
